steps.en: Officer opens the Manage Template screen
Officer browses the SMS template list
Officer browses the email template list
Officer browses the letter template list
steps.why_en: The screen has only SMS and Email tabs; letter templates cannot be browsed.
steps.why_id: Layar hanya punya tab SMS dan Email; template letter tidak bisa ditelusuri.

steps.en: Officer finds templates by processing stage or notice type
steps.id: Officer mencari template per processing stage atau notice type
steps.why_en: Search works on remarks only; stage shows only inside the template name and notice type is not searchable.
steps.why_id: Pencarian hanya lewat remarks; stage hanya terlihat di nama template dan notice type tidak bisa dicari.

steps.en: Officer opens a template and saves an amended version
steps.id: Officer membuka template dan menyimpan versi yang sudah di-amend

steps.en: Templates are used at the different processing stages
steps.id: Template dipakai di berbagai processing stage
steps.why_en: SMS and email are looked up per stage, but some email stages are skipped and letters use only one template.
steps.why_id: SMS dan email dicari per stage, tapi beberapa stage email dilewati dan letter hanya memakai satu template.
